text_markup: Paid abilities that begin with [click] are actions and have special timing rules (see {ref:sec_actions}). Aside from taking actions, there are no special restrictions to how or when a player can spend their clicks during their turn.
text_plain: Paid abilities that begin with {click} are actions and have special timing rules (see section 5.2). Aside from taking actions, there are no special restrictions to how or when a player can spend their clicks during their turn.
